name: Azeroth Companion
title: Player Field Lab — Feedback & Character Planning Intelligence
features: Introduced Player Field Lab: a 12-check acceptance-testing workflow for friends using the companion with real Retail characters, with clear Pass, Issue, Blocked and Not Tested states.
Added browser-local player feedback notes and privacy-safe copy/download reports; notes and device category are optional, and no reports are sent automatically.
Added Planning Readiness: a read-only summary of locally saved characters, open item targets, logged farming sessions, manual Atlas ownership marks and Loot Hunter objectives.
Linked Player Field Lab from the Information & Player Guide and retained the existing desktop sidebar and iPhone All Tools navigation.
Provided one-click links from Planning Readiness to character dashboards, targets, farming operations and Sovereign Data Vault.
Added controlled test-result deletion without altering existing WoW planning records, Blizzard authentication, or account sessions.
Preserved separation between Blizzard-reported game data and manually recorded player progress, with no additional OAuth scopes or backend deployment.
Expanded automated regression checks for report privacy, tool navigation, character summary inputs and mobile styling.
